body:
ten songs. one artist. the entire top 10 of the hot 100, all in the same week.

november 5, 2022: every slot in the chart’s top ten belonged to taylor. nobody had managed it in the hot 100’s 64 years — drake got closest with nine, the year before.

all ten were midnights tracks. "anti-hero" led at no. 1 on 59.7 million streams, and behind it came lavender haze, maroon, snow on the beach, midnight rain, bejeweled, question…?, you’re on your own kid, karma and vigilante shit.

every one of them a brand-new debut. radio had not caught up yet, so streams alone set the order — and all 20 songs on the album charted that week.

her own words, watching it happen: "in shambles."

why: TONIGHT’S SLOT, REWRITTEN (not dropped). Supersedes 2026-08-11-midnights-3am-surprise-ig.json, which opened with the banned "did you know" formula. Same era, deliberately a different and stronger subject: the 3am-tracks story echoed the 08-10 TTPD Anthology post that shipped yesterday, so this uses the Hot 100 top-10 sweep instead — hook shape "the number", per strategy §1(d) rule 5. Every claim traces to the Vault Midnights item "Taylor becomes the first artist to hold the entire Hot 100 top 10" (sourced Billboard ×2 + Wikipedia): the Nov. 5, 2022 chart, first in the Hot 100’s 64-year history, Drake’s nine in 2021, the ten titles in order, "Anti-Hero" at No. 1 on 59.7M U.S. streams, all 20 album tracks charting that week, streaming-driven debuts ahead of radio, and her own "in shambles." MEDIA JUSTIFICATION (era-art, last rung of the ladder): the new library assets in PR #1903 are not deployed yet and Instagram fetches media from the live site at post time, so tonight’s only deployed-and-honest option is /eras/midnights.png. Verified guard-safe — the last 10 posted Instagram items used 1989, tloas, debut, folklore, speak-now, evermore, red, reputation, fearless and ttpd; midnights.png is not among them. Chart lore only, outside every #36/Clownbot blocklist topic. The X sibling that sat at 23:20Z is deleted rather than rewritten: strategy §2 says heartbeat days never sibling-pair.
